Planned commands (flag spelling confirmed with each --help; only isolation may be added, never removed)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
codex exec -C <export>/slices/<SLICE> --sandbox read-only --skip-git-repo-check --ephemeral
  -m gpt-6.1-sol -c model_reasoning_effort="xhigh" --output-schema <schema copy outside the export>
  -o <raw output file in a temp folder outside the export and the repository> "<PROMPT.md text>"
  plus, to keep codex from using tools outside its sandbox: --disable plugins --disable apps
  --disable browser_use --disable computer_use -c mcp_servers.base44.enabled=false
  -c mcp_servers.node_repl.enabled=false (checked locally: with these flags codex mcp list shows every
  MCP server disabled; without them node_repl, cua_repl and a base44 web connector are enabled).
agy --print "<PROMPT.md text>" --model gemini-4-argon-high --output-format json --sandbox
  --json-schema <schema copy outside the export>, with the process working folder = <export>/slices/<SLICE>
  (agy mcp list: no MCP servers; agy plugin list: no plugins).

Read confinement (checked BEFORE any code is sent; the probe sends no repository code)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Each approved assistant is first run, with the same flags, in an EMPTY folder and asked to list what it
can see and to print a harmless canary file placed next to that folder (random token made at run time,
never printed) and the repository package.json. Pass = its output contains neither the token nor the
package name. A failed probe stops that assistant before any code is sent and goes back to the operator
(options: run it in a container that can see only the export, leave it out, or send nothing).
Known in advance: the codex documentation for 0.163.0 states that its legacy read-only mode on Windows
allows reading the whole file system (it blocks writes, not reads). The plain codex probe is therefore
expected to FAIL; codex is then not sent anything until the operator chooses how to proceed.
